redeem.signInWithPassword: سجّل الدخول بكلمة مرور بدلًا من ذلك
redeem.tellUsWhoYouAre: أخبرنا من أنت وستكون داخل التطبيق فورًا — بلا كلمة مرور، وبلا رمز تنتظره.
redeem.throttledBody: رابطك سليم — فتحه عدد كبير من الأشخاص من هنا في الدقائق القليلة الماضية. انتظر بضع دقائق ثم افتحه مجددًا.
redeem.tooManyAtOnce: عدد كبير جدًا من الأشخاص في وقت واحد
redeem.typeTheCode: اكتب الرمز الذي أعطاك إياه معلّمك أو المسؤول.

schools.setPasswordBody: Right now the only way back into this account is a code emailed to you — and school email filters often swallow those. A password takes ten seconds and always works.
schools.typeNameToConfirm: Type the name exactly to confirm
schools.assignLede: Tick every class {name} should teach. Unticking a class they teach now takes them off it — so a move is one change here, not two.
schools.noClassesYet: No classes in this school yet. Create a class first, then come back and staff it.
schools.noTeacherYet: no teacher yet — they'd lead it
schools.addStudentsLater: You can add students from the class page whenever you're ready.
schools.everyLiveCourse: Every live course, no per-course selection.
schools.loginLede: Sign in to see how your class is doing, play a session together, or jump into the analytics for the week. We work on Chromebooks, tablets and phones — and we never store student passwords.
schools.loginLedePassword: Enter the email your school registered with us, and your password.
schools.loginLedeCode: Enter the email address your school registered with us. We'll send a single-use code.
schools.sessionExpired: Your session has expired — please sign in again.
schools.codeFilterFootnotePre: Codes from us are often blocked by school email filters. If yours never arrives, ask whoever runs your school’s account to open your school and tap
schools.codeFilterFootnotePost: next to your name. They can read the code out to you — no email at all, and you can set a password the moment you are in.
schools.expiresInHour: It expires in about an hour.
schools.deliveryHintPre: Still nothing? School email filters block these codes outright, and there is nothing you can do at your end about it. Two ways in that need no email: sign in with a
schools.deliveryHintMid: if you have set one — or ask whoever runs your school’s account to open your school and tap
schools.deliveryHintPost: next to your name, and read it out to you. Still stuck?
schools.noSchoolFoundPre: We couldn't find a school account linked to
schools.noSchoolFoundPost: Ask your school admin for a join code, or set up a new school below.
schools.settingUpNewSchool: I'm setting up a new school →
schools.imATutor: I'm a tutor — go to my dashboard →
schools.justHereToLearn: Just here to learn → go to the app
schools.trialEndedLede: Subscribe below to keep your classes, analytics and student progress. Your data is safe — nothing is deleted.
schools.pastDueBanner: There's a problem with your school's payment. Please update your card to avoid losing access.

schools.coTeacherNote: You teach this class alongside its lead teacher. Only the lead teacher or a school leader can bring another colleague in.
schools.manyTeachersNotePre: A class can have as many teachers as you like, and a teacher can take as many classes as you like. Use
schools.manyTeachersNotePost: on anyone above to put them on another class, or to move them off this one.

schools.createFirstClassBody: Create your first class to start teaching with SSi. Students join with a unique code.
schools.joinedExistingSchool: Joined a school that already has classes? A school leader has to put you on one — ask them to add you, and it will appear here.
schools.tryWideningStudents: Try widening the class, belt or health filter.
schools.noStudentsBody: Once students join your classes via their invite link, they'll appear here.
schools.bulkImportSoon: Bulk CSV import is coming soon. For now, share the teacher invite link below — teachers click it, sign in once, and land in your school.
schools.copyInviteHint: Copy the teacher invite link below and share it however you reach your staff — Teams, WhatsApp, in person. Clicking it signs them straight in.
schools.accessCodeBody: Read this out to {name}, write it down, or paste it into Teams — however you normally reach them. They go to
schools.accessCodeCaveat: It works once, and lasts two days. Whoever uses it becomes {name}, so give it to them directly and don't post it anywhere shared. Need another? Just tap Access code again.
schools.noTeachersBody: Share the invite link below to add teachers to your school.
schools.tipInviteLinksBody: Anyone who clicks your teacher invite link appears here as a teacher once they sign in — so share it only with your staff. You can remove a teacher from their row at any time.
schools.tipRolesBody: Admins manage staff, classes and settings. Teachers see only their own classes. Switch role any time from a teacher's row.
schools.shareStaffLink: Share this link however you reach your staff — Teams, WhatsApp, in person. Clicking it signs them straight in.
schools.whiteboardHelpTeachers: For writing on a whiteboard — teachers enter it at
schools.approxPracticeTitle: Approximate — no session logs for this course, derived from course position
schools.noCoursesYetBody: You haven't enrolled in any courses yet. Ask your teacher for a class join code.
schools.addSchoolLede: Creates the school in your programme immediately, with an admin link and a teacher link ready to share.
schools.addSchoolHint: Send the school admin the Admin link — clicking it takes them straight to sign-in. These links also live on the school's row any time you need them again.
schools.nobodyElseOnStaff: Nobody else on the staff list yet — a colleague has to join the school before you can share the class with them.
schools.colleagueNotOnList: Colleague not on the staff list yet? Send them a link into this class.

setup.step3Desc: Pick which languages to use for classes.
setup.title: Let's get your school set up.
setup.lede: Four steps. About ten minutes. You can come back and finish any time — we'll keep your place.
setup.inviteLede: Share this invite link however you reach your staff — Teams, WhatsApp, in person. Clicking it signs them straight in. Anyone can teach: the app does the teaching, so a teacher doesn't need to speak the language.
setup.inviteLinksLater: Your invite links will appear here once your school is saved.
setup.chooseCoursesLede: Pick which of your school's available courses you'll use for classes. This just narrows the list you choose from in the next step — it doesn't change who has access.
setup.noCoursesAvailable: Your school doesn't have any courses available yet — get in touch with us and we'll sort it out. You can continue and add classes once courses are available.
setup.createClassesLede: Name your first classes and pick a course for each. You can add students from each class page whenever you're ready.
setup.noCoursesToChoose: No courses to choose from yet —
setup.noCoursesToChoosePost: to pick which ones to use, or get in touch with us if your school has none available.
